source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: While this model keeps an [invulnerable save](vsdata:core-rule/save-rolls), its unit can re-roll none of its **save rolls**. After it loses a wound to anything other than [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), it has no invulnerable save for the rest of the battle.

effects.condition: this model has an invulnerable save
effects.subject: this unit

effects.effect: this model has no invulnerable save
